summary: Master gender-responsive healthcare strategies using GESI and WHO frameworks. Learn to audit facilities and implement inclusive health policies. Enroll today.
lede: Gender-responsive healthcare examines how gender-related barriers shape access to services and care. For health policy analysts, hospital administrators, program coordinators and clinical leaders, this training covers practical ways to assess equity, work with gender-disaggregated data, design inclusive clinical pathways and workforce practices, and plan gender-responsive health budgets.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for health system design, policy implementation, and clinical service management who need to integrate gender-responsive strategies into their operations.
audience: Maternal and Child Health Program Coordinators
GESI Specialists focused on health system social
modules: Gender-Responsive Clinical Pathways and Service Delivery
Digital Health Innovation and the Gender Gap
Policy, Law, and International Health Standards
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in healthcare management, public health policy, or clinical leadership. A basic understanding of health statistics and familiarity with national health strategic plans is recommended. No prior experience with GESI frameworks is required, but participants should be prepared to engage with data-driven analysis tools.
